The document itself shows that only the scoped case used a real reviewer; the unscoped case used `REVIEWER_AGENT=cat`. Update the evidence introduction, conclusion, and issue document label to reflect the revised criterion: mechanism trace plus one real scoped run, with full behavioral comparison deferred.
